title: 09. Production & Safety: Semantic Cache
summary: Cache LLM responses so that similar questions get the cached answer instead of calling the LLM again. Not just exact matches — semantically similar queries hit the cache too.

title: 09. Production & Safety: Rate Limiting & Throttling
summary: Rate limiting controls how many requests a user/service can make in a time window. Without it, one misbehaving client can exhaust your API quota, causing everyone to experience failures.

title: 09. Production & Safety: Retry Logic & Exponential Backoff
summary: APIs fail transiently — network hiccup, rate limit hit, server overload. Retry logic automatically retries failed calls with exponential backoff (increasing wait times) so temporary issues don't cause permanent failures.

title: 09. Production & Safety: Circuit Breaker
summary: When a downstream service is failing repeatedly, a circuit breaker opens (stops sending requests) to prevent cascade failures. After a timeout it half-opens (tests one request) and if successful, closes (resumes normal traffic).

title: 09. Production & Safety: Prompt Injection Guard
summary: Prompt injection = an attacker embeds malicious instructions inside content your agent processes (documents, web pages, user inputs). The LLM "reads" the hidden instructions and executes them.
objectives: How Prompt Injection Works & How to Stop It

title: 09. Production & Safety: Input Validation
summary: Every user input must be validated before it reaches the LLM or any tool. Validation checks: length, content type, allowed characters, banned topics, and structural integrity.

title: 09. Production & Safety: Output Guardrails
summary: Even after validation, LLMs can generate harmful, biased, inaccurate, or off-brand content. Output guardrails check the LLM's response before sending it to the user.

title: 09. Production & Safety: PII Detection & Masking
summary: PII (Personally Identifiable Information) must never be stored in LLM context, logged, or returned to unauthorized users. PII detection finds it and masking anonymizes it.

title: 09. Production & Safety: Tool Safety Controls
summary: Tools give agents real power — reading files, executing code, calling APIs, deleting records. This power must be constrained.
